newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Layne Christensen bids for Stanley.
newsitem.headline: Layne Christensen bids for Stanley.

text.p: Australian mining contractor Stanley Mining Services Ltd said it received on Tuesday a takeover offer of A$0.90 per share from Layne Christensen Australia Pty Ltd, a wholly-owned unit of Layne Christensen Co of Mission Woods, Kansas.
Stanley said its shareholders would also be entitled to receive a special fully franked dividend of up to five cents a share which Layne expects to be declared before the end of the offer period.

Should the special dividend not be declared, or should the amount of the dividend be less than five cents per share, Layne would increase the cash component of the offer so that shareholders will receive 95 cents a share by way of cash and dividend, Stanley said.
Based on 95 cents a share, the proposed Layne offer values Stanley's issued capital of 70,219,325 shares at A$66.7 million.
Layne will also offer to acquire all outstanding options to subscribe for unissued Stanley shares.
The offer price for the options will be the difference between the offer price for the shares and the exercise price of the options.

The offers will be subject to a number of conditions, including acceptances being received for at least 90 percent of the issued shares in Stanley, Australian Foreign Investment Review Board (FIRB) approval and the holders of all outstanding options accepting Layne's offers.
The proposed offer price compares with Stanley's last traded price of 77 cents before trading in the shares was suspended on Monday at the company's request.
The Australian Stock Exchange said the shares will be reinstated to official quotation prior to the start of trading on Wednesday.
